headline: Olavis Wake Aflame; Weathered Expanse Ground Changes Hands Again
war_summary: The northern line has shifted again in the three hours since the last edition. Weathered Expanse, where Wardens held four works at that hour, now stands three apiece with three unclaimed, six actions reported in the past two hours after sixty-one across the day; the day's cost there is set at 7,389 Colonial and 9,300 Warden fallen. Kuura Strand, which flared at mid-morning, has quieted to nothing in the last two hours, its six-hour tally seven, and now reads three works for each side with none unclaimed. Freshest is Olavis Wake, where four actions in two hours and twenty-two in the day are reported about Iltaku, Kulkue and Koskinla; the day's toll is 4,007 Colonial and 3,882 Warden, the hex standing two Warden works to three Colonial. Marban Hollow likewise reports two actions in two hours and twenty-six in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, holdings one Warden, five Colonial, two unclaimed. Linn Mercy keeps two actions in two hours at Outwich Ranch, eighteen in the day, and Pari Peak two at Pariah. The Nevish Line has fallen silent in the last two hours after nineteen actions in the day. At Callahan's Passage the slaughter continues with no ground changing hands, 6,466 Colonial and 4,491 Warden in a day, while Dead Lands casualties have leapt sharply in the past hour, though no base there has changed hands.
